title: Make inu OL: Mainichi ga hatsujôki
original_title: 負け犬ＯＬ 毎日が発情期
overview: Kaori, Mei, and Minako are close friends and office workers. Since Minako left her job to get married, their boss has become more aggressive in pressuring them about their own marriages, but the other two have deflected her questions with loser-like remarks. Kaori was content with her lover, an art gallery owner, and Mei was happy with her comfortable life at home and having two partners. Then, after some time had passed, the two, still enjoying their good relationship, were drinking at their favorite bar when Minako, now divorced, suddenly appeared…
